						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icm value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icm23 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 135 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 125 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 120 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icf value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icf24 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icm value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icm24 }
					}
					else = {
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icf value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icf25 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icm value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icm25 }
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 130 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icf value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icf26 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icm value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icm26 }
					}
					else = {
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icf value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icf27 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icm value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icm27 }
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 145 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 140 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icf value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icf28 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icm value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icm28 }
					}
					else = {
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icf value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icf29 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icm value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icm29 }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icf value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icf30 }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_icm value = local_var:te_dg_umu_icm30 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state, in te_demog_lx_group_flush while te_dg_um_sums: the age group local_var:te_dg_g's treated
# infection-and-chronic sums (people x rate at their biological age), by sex, into te_dg_uma_tic<f|m><group>; the
# running sums start again.
te_demog_um_group_flush = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 15 }

			limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 7 }

# THIS = a state, in te_demog_um_step: the treated infection-and-chronic sums over every age group, women's and men's,
# into te_dg_um_sf and te_dg_um_sm (the uploads' split by sex).
te_demog_um_sex_sums = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf value = 0 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf0 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf1 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf2 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf3 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf4 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf5 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf6 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf7 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf8 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf9 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf10 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf11 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf12 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf13 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf14 }

	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf18 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf19 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf20 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf21 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf22 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf23 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf24 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf25 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf26 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf27 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf28 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf29 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sf add = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf30 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_sm value = 0 }

# THIS = a state, in te_demog_um_step after the late sweep (demographics_uploads.l100_counting): Living to 100 with an
# upload counting as living, the state's blended table (te_demog_lx_tables') with the treated's infection and chronic
# deaths x (1 - local te_dg_um_u, the share of them that uploaded); women's and men's averaged, into te_dg_um_l100.
te_demog_um_l100 = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_lf value = 100000 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_lm value = 100000 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_q value = local_var:te_dg_lxu_qf0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_n value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lxa_uf0 add = local_var:te_dg_lxa_tf0 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_dg_um_n > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_q value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lxa_uf0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_lxu_qf0 add = local_var:te_dg_lxa_tqf0 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticf0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_um_u } divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_um_n min = 0.00001 } } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_p value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_um_q divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_pn value = 1 }
	while = { count = 1 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_pn multiply = local_var:te_dg_um_p } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_lf multiply = local_var:te_dg_um_pn }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_q value = local_var:te_dg_lxu_qm0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_n value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lxa_um0 add = local_var:te_dg_lxa_tm0 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_dg_um_n > 0 } set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_q value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lxa_um0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_lxu_qm0 add = local_var:te_dg_lxa_tqm0 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_uma_ticm0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_um_u } divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_um_n min = 0.00001 } } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_p value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_um_q divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_pn value = 1 }
	while = { count = 1 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_pn multiply = local_var:te_dg_um_p } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_lm multiply = local_var:te_dg_um_pn }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_um_q value = local_var:te_dg_lxu_qf1 }
